references.text: Psalm 107:23-30 describes sailors experiencing a storm and God calming it, which resembles the event in Matthew 8:24.
Isaiah 43:2 speaks of walking through water without being overwhelmed, which can be seen as a parallel to trials of faith and God's protection, similar to the situation the disciples faced.
Luke 8:22-25 also gives a parallel account of Jesus calming the storm, pointing to the same miraculous event.
